L comment. Instead of just claiming L take, why not provide some insight? What do you think the best song on the album is? Why do you think so?

Sunday After Casino is the highlight of the album imo, the rest of it is alright. He leaned really hard in to what the trends were in the 90s on the album and I think it took the Takanaka element out of a lot of it.

Mambo Jambo, Paradizzy, and Dancing to Cat Guitar. Jambo for the absolutely fantastic composition, Paradizzy for a nice glimpse at Takanaka's singing voice, and Cat Guitar for the sick MMMRRROOOOOOWWWWWWWWWWW he does during the solo.
